title: Letters of map change.
officialText: Where applicable, the certificate of occupancy shall indicate that “the structure is exempted from the area of special flood hazard pursuant to FEMA Letter of Map Amendment (LOMA) # (_______),” or that “the structure is exempted from the area of special flood hazard pursuant to FEMA Letter of Map Revision Based on Fill (LOMR-F) # (_______),” or that “the structure is exempted from the area of special flood hazard pursuant to FEMA Letter of Map Revision (LOMR) # (_______).”
